tests.name: Boots with six agents and six sample features
Six independently interactive map nodes
Single example feature is visibly complete
Selecting a map agent updates the inspector
Agent edits persist across editor tabs
Duplicate gets a distinct ID and name
Uploaded avatar is validated, resized and stored
Deletion removes agent and project association
Project creation captures briefing, commander, squad and features
Feature creation stores scope, priority and dependencies
Feature search filters the board
Cyclic dependencies are rejected without changing data
Commander reports missing specialists
Handoff view switches to purple routing
Manual handoff records context and updates the pending route
Demo can be paused
Paused simulation does not advance
Simulated handoff produces per-agent reports
Completed route requires human review, not auto-approval
Human approval marks only reviewed feature complete
Commander generates specialist routes by feature scope
Approved dependency unlocks downstream feature
Sequential simulation processes the available queue
Review can request another iteration
Individual spawn uses only the selected agent and returns to review
Progress reaches 100 percent only after human approval
Zoom controls change the map camera
Home restores the camera scale
Canvas pan moves the camera
Shift-drag persists a custom agent position
Point-cloud visualization can be enabled
Focus mode hides interactive HUD regions
Focus mode can restore all panels
Handoff history shows accumulated transfers
Operation log is readable and filterable
Workspace serializes and rehydrates with the storage fixture
Exported snapshot is isolated from internal state
Invalid workspace versions are rejected
Unknown roles are rejected
Unsafe uploaded image URLs are removed on import
No network requests are needed
No uncaught browser errors
Mobile layout has no horizontal page overflow
Mobile agent selection opens the controllable studio
Mobile feature board is accessible and horizontally scrollable

limitations: Managed Chromium URL navigation blocked; set_content and a Storage-compatible in-memory fixture used.
No authenticated Claude Code runtime was tested.
